A. History and Development of the Company
TNL Mediagene (formerly “The
News Lens Co., Ltd.”) was incorporated as a Cayman Islands exempted company on January 20, 2015, and changed its name to TNL Mediagene
on August 14, 2023 as a result of the merger between TNL and Mediagene in May 2023. We operate media, technology and digital studio businesses
primarily in Japan and Taiwan. Each predecessor company brought unique capabilities to TNL Mediagene — TNL’s data analytics, advertising
technologies and direct-to-client advertising sales platform, and Mediagene’s portfolio of trusted digital media brands in the Japanese
market, innovative content marketing, integrated marketing, live events and retail media capabilities — while maintaining our shared
core values and focus on high-quality independent digital media publishing. We are strategically pivoting toward expanding our digital
studio business and deploying AI-based technology across our operations, with the aim of enhancing operational efficiency and developing
new products and services.
Business Combination
with Blue Ocean
On December 5, 2024, we consummated
the previously announced Business Combination with Blue Ocean Acquisition Corp. On December 6, 2024, TNL Mediagene Ordinary Shares commenced
trading on the Nasdaq under the symbol “TNMG” and TNL Mediagene Warrants commenced trading over the counter, or OTC.

B. Business Overview
Overview
We are a digital media and
technology company operating multi-language news, lifestyle, and tech brands across Asia, and providing AI-driven advertising, data analytics,
e-commerce, and marketing technology solutions. We operate digital media, technology and digital studio businesses primarily in Japan
and Taiwan. Through our trusted digital media brands, AI-powered advertising and data analytics technology and digital studio solutions,
we aim to provide multinational clients with unmatched opportunities to contextually reach and engage with Millennial and Gen Z audiences
across the East Asian region, one of the largest and most attractive audience segments in the world. We are strategically growing our
digital studio business, which is our largest revenue segment, and deploying AI-based technology to drive operational efficiency in our
digital media business and to develop new products and services, initially within our digital studio business. Through our trusted digital
media brands, AI-powered technology solutions and digital studio capabilities, we aim to provide multinational clients with a differentiated
platform to engage with Millennial and Gen Z audiences across Japan and Taiwan.
Digital Studio —Our
integrated digital studios, agencies and market research teams provide a comprehensive suite of strategic, creative design, research
and communication services that help our clients reach and engage their target audiences and build communities for their brands. Our
digital studio business is our primary growth focus. We are developing new AI-assisted products and services to enhance the quality and
efficiency of the creative and strategic services we deliver to our clients. We began developing AI-assisted offerings within our digital
studio business in the fourth quarter of 2025, and AI tools are now broadly deployed across many of our digital studio client engagements.
We expect to continue expanding these capabilities over time. We believe the combination of our digital studio capabilities, access to
our Millennial and Gen Z audiences in Japan and Taiwan, and the integration of AI-based technology tools positions us to expand our client
relationships and develop new revenue streams. For the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024 and 2025, we recorded $15.4 million,
$20.5 million and $18.7 million of revenue, respectively, from our digital studio business.
Media and Branded Content —As
an independent digital media publisher, we are committed to being a “trusted voice in Asia for a better future” for Millennial
and Gen Z audiences in Japan, Taiwan and throughout the East and, ultimately, Southeast Asia region and to inspire and enliven what the
most online and connected generations watch, read, hear and buy, now and in the future. For the twelve months ended March 31, 2026, our
26 digital media brands across five content categories, news and business, B2B media, technology, lifestyle and food, and sports and
entertainment, have reached over 36 million average monthly unique users, or MUU, which we define as the average monthly unique
users of our owned digital media sites and accounts on social media platforms such as YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and X, in
three languages, Japanese, Chinese and English, with over 216 million average monthly digital footprints across websites, social-media
platforms and mobile apps. Our digital media portfolio includes not only regional editions of globally recognized brands, but also independent,
market-leading digital media brands developed in-house. The implementation of AI translation technology allows us to widen our reach
across different countries, languages, media brands and platforms, and to adapt and rapidly cross-pollinate content from one country,
language, media brand or platform to another, reaching audiences wherever they live, whatever languages they speak and whatever platform
they use across our own digital media brands. Through our digital media brands, we build trust and engagement with our Millennial and
Gen Z audiences, allowing us to deliver highly targeted and effective advertising for our clients outside traditional social-media and
content platforms. For the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024 and 2025, we recorded $9.8 million, $13.7 million
and $12.9 million, respectively, of revenue from our media and branded content business.
Technology —Our
data analytics and AI-powered technology underpins our digital media and digital studio operations, enabling more efficient content production
and targeted advertising delivery. Our 26 trusted digital media brands cover diverse categories, offering high engagement with the growing
and affluent digital-native generations primarily in Japan and Taiwan, and deliver high-quality advertisement performance in the digital
advertising and growing retail media spaces. We have represented over 850 regional and global advertising clients across diverse industries,
including multinational companies and government agencies. We provide our clients with a one-stop access point for their digital advertising
and marketing needs, allowing them to connect and engage with audiences primarily in Japan and Taiwan. Our proprietary first- and zero-party
data assets continue to support our advertising and data analytics services, providing advertising clients with targeted access to engaged
Millennial and Gen Z audiences, including through retail media and performance advertising solutions. For the years ended December 31,
2023, 2024 and 2025, we recorded $10.6 million, $14.2 million and $13.5 million of revenue, respectively, from our technology
business.
Our Strengths
We are Asia’s next-generation media company that operates a highly
differentiated combination of (i) digital studio business through our integrated digital studios, agencies and market research teams providing
a comprehensive suite of strategic, creative design, research and communication services, (ii) digital media and branded content business
through our 26 trusted and independent digital media brands with prominently Millennial and Gen Z audiences, and (iii) technology business
through our proprietary data analytics and advertising technology products and services powered by AI and our first- and zero-party audience
data. We believe the digital media industry is at an inflection point where the traditional business model of focusing on audience growth
and mass reach is being phased out. Data analytics and advertising technology that require high-quality audience data are taking the center
